svg.text: reference map: when to read each
agent-handoff v4.0.1: what loads, and when
Three layers. A request loads SKILL.md, then one L2 file, then only the L3 files its steps name. Word counts are measured from the files.
L2 references/ one file per command
L3 references/ read at the step that names it
every entry · only the backends in use
a gate at its cap · a contested call
a row that is not a text diff
scripts/ run through Bash, never read into context
submit · status · result · resume · cancel · cleanup
hash-checked read and write of goal.md
A delegated run on codex + claude
Arbitration, e2e, artefact rows and PR
delivery load only when a run reaches them.
L1 and L2: loaded by command
